AboutPage.title: About Me
AboutPage.metaDescription: Get to know Violin Mulya Putra, an Information Technology student at Universitas Gadjah Mada from Semarang, interested in software development, data analysis, IoT, and interface design.

intro.p1: Hello! My name is Violin Mulya Putra. I am from Semarang, Central Java.
intro.p2: I am an Information Technology student at Universitas Gadjah Mada, currently in my third year of study.
intro.p3: I have a strong interest in software development, data analysis, the Internet of Things (IoT), and interface design.

roots.p1: My interest in technology actually grew out of my family environment. As it happens, my father also works in the IT industry. As a child, I often watched him work at home.
roots.p2: Seeing him turn lines of code into a system that benefits many people amazed me and made me curious.
roots.p3: My journey in the world of IT began from those simple moments.

growth.p1: Over time, I realized that I enjoy designing User Interfaces and User Experiences (UI/UX), from exploring layouts and choosing typography to picking the right color palette.
growth.p2: At the same time, topics related to data analysis and IoT also made me eager to learn more deeply.
growth.p3: I am always eager to keep learning, try new things, and grow in the technology industry!
